title: checkin_resource.c: set_time override writes unlocked (torn 64-bit read on 32-bit targets)
description: checkin_resource.c:45-49 lichen_checkin_resource_set_time writes s_time_overridden/s_time_override without s_lock while resource_now() reads them under it - torn 64-bit read possible on 32-bit targets. Fix: take s_lock in the setter.
close_reason: lichen_checkin_resource_set_time now takes s_lock around the s_time_overridden/s_time_override writes; resource_now() reads them under the same lock (only caller path is service_tick_locked, invoked with the mutex held), closing the torn 64-bit read on 32-bit targets. Verified: twister lichen.checkin_resource on qemu_x86_64 8/8 test cases passed.
